text:
Eli: Thinking about fallback UX that respects customer quotas/budgets. Idea: when a fallback would increase per-token cost, prefer cheaper variants or throttle fallback so not to blow a customer's monthly commit. Want to discuss console affordances + API flags.
Nora: Good call. We need two knobs: billing_attribution (target|original|budget-safe) and an advisory cost-estimate shown in the UI before enabling any fallback stage.
Pat: On triggers: fallback shouldn't just look at errors/latency. Add quota_headroom trigger: if projected_spend_on_fallback > remaining_budget * 0.25 then reduce sample rate or block automatic fallback.
Zoe: UX idea: show a small orange "Quota-aware" badge in rollout timeline when fallback is suppressed by budget. Clicking opens a mini-panel with: estimated added cost, remaining budget, suggested actions (snooze, reduce sample, escalate to paid-plan).
Eli: API sketch (pseudo): fallback_policy: mode=soft|hard|quota_aware, billing=original|target|budget_safe, budget_threshold=0.25, cost_estimate=true. Example: ```json
{
  \"fallback_policy\": {
    \"mode\": \"quota_aware\",
    \"triggers\": [{\"metric\":\"error_rate\",\"thresh\":0.05,\"window_s\":300}],
    \"sample_fraction\":0.02,
    \"billing_attribution\":\"budget_safe\",
    \"budget_threshold\":0.25
  }
}
```
Nora: Console should also offer an override flow: "Approve fallback despite budget impact" — that creates an audit event and sends a billing approval email to finance. Must require two approvals for > $X/day delta.
Pat: Telemetry additions: budget_sensitive_flag, projected_delta_cents, decision_reason (ENUM: TRIGGER_ERROR, TRIGGER_LATENCY, BLOCKED_BUDGET), decision_id. Keep fields optional.
Zoe: For the UI, when fallback is blocked by budget show a one-click "Simulate reduced sample" that suggests new sample fractions and shows expected latency/quality deltas and cost. Also a "Contact finance" link prepopulates an approval email with numbers.
Eli: Edge cases: what if multiple tenants share a Dedicated pool and one tenant has low budget? Routing should be per-tenant. The platform must avoid cross-tenant cost bleed. We'll need tenant-scoped routing and cost attribution.
Nora: Good point. Add tenant_id in decision telemetry and in rollout config allow overrides per tenant. Also show per-tenant cost heatmap in the rollout panel.
Pat: Implementation note: cost estimate must be fast. Use recent token rate * model_cost_per_token. Keep a conservative multiplier for unknowns. Cache per-model cost and decay historical token/sec to predict short-term spend.
Zoe: Audit requirements: if operator overrides budget block, append reason, operator, and optional ticket. Show the chain of approvals in the timeline. Also provide a CSV export for finance with decision_id and projected delta.
infra-bot: Recorded: feature-flag created: quota-aware-fallback -> ff-6262.
Eli: Billing nuance: budget_safe billing maps fallback compute to a special 'budget pool' that uses a capped spend mode (throttles fallback). If the pool is exhausted, the policy transitions to fallback=false. Need to design pool lifecycle.
Nora: Alerting: if repeated budget-blocked fallbacks happen for a single customer show a customer health signal to CSM with suggested upsell. Add a reason code BUDG_BLOCK to group alerts.
Pat: QA: tests for deterministic decision with budget boundary, and e2e where budget-block toggles sample fraction. Also check that cost estimates are within reasonable error bounds (±20%).
Zoe: UI mockups: small modal for override approvals, per-tenant rows in rollout matrix, and an export button. I'll mock and add accessibility notes.
Eli: I'll draft an RFC with API fields, telemetry schema, billing pool design, and operator runbook. Assign @Zoe for mockups, @Pat for cost estimator impl/tests, and @Nora for billing/approval flows.
billing-bot: Created billing ticket: BL-3472 "quota-aware fallback approval flow"
Eli: Thanks all — will follow up with a short prototype in the console and a test script to exercise budget edgecases.
